security_audit.summary: All 35 static detections are false positives caused by Markdown fences, inline code, fixed URLs, and relative documentation links. The skill contains no executable commands, network requests, environment access, or path traversal logic. A medium concern remains because its sequencing and mailbox-distribution guidance can support unsolicited bulk outreach despite embedded compliance controls.

remediation.issue: Cold outreach planning can be repurposed for unsolicited bulk messaging or provider-limit evasion.
remediation.suggestion: Prohibit harvested lists, deceptive identities, high-volume spam, and provider-limit evasion. Require a documented lawful basis before producing a campaign plan.

content.user_title: Build Compliant B2B Cold Outbound Sequences
content.value_statement: Cold outreach programs often lack clear sequencing, reply routing, delivery controls, and jurisdiction safeguards. This skill creates a structured sequence, warmup plan, triage map, and compliance guidance.
actual_capabilities: Designs multi-step B2B outbound sequences with timing, goals, and explicit exit rules.
Maps positive, objection, referral, not-now, opt-out, and bounce responses to clear next actions.
Produces per-mailbox warmup ramps and steady-state daily send caps.
Lists CAN-SPAM elements and flags consent-first jurisdiction concerns.
Reads the SEND sender-integrity dimension from available authentication, reputation, bounce, complaint, and consent information.
Creates a reusable handoff summary and saves it after user confirmation.
limitations: Does not write final email copy, send messages, or configure live email platforms.
Does not provide legal advice or determine the lawful basis for a contact list.
Does not compute the complete Email Quality Score or enforce final quality vetoes.
Results depend on supplied data; missing evidence remains NEEDS_INPUT, N/A, or clearly labeled as estimated.

use_cases.title: Launch a Founder-Led Campaign
use_cases.description: A startup founder maps initial touches, response exits, and compliance questions before drafting outreach.

use_cases.title: Standardize Sales Development Outreach
use_cases.description: A sales operations manager defines consistent timing, reply routing, and handoff rules across representatives.

use_cases.title: Protect New Sending Infrastructure
use_cases.description: A deliverability specialist plans mailbox warmup, volume caps, and evidence checks for a new sending domain.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Sequence
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a five-step B2B cold outbound sequence for [ICP]. Include timing, goals, and exit rules. Assume [jurisdiction] and [list source].
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a complete sequence map from basic campaign inputs.

prompt_templates.title: Route Every Reply
prompt_templates.prompt: Design reply triage for this sequence. Route positive, objection, referral, not-now, opt-out, and bounce responses to clear next actions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Add consistent reply handling and stop conditions to an existing sequence.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Mailbox Warmup
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a four-week warmup for [mailbox count] new mailboxes on [domain age]. Set weekly daily caps and label estimates.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare new sending infrastructure before regular campaign volume begins.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Sender Integrity
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this program using SEND S. Use [authentication], [bounce rate], [complaint rate], and [consent record]. Identify every missing input.
prompt_templates.scenario: Perform an advanced delivery and evidence review before quality auditing.

output_examples.input: Create a five-step sequence for operations leaders at mid-market software companies in the United States.
output: Sequence: five touches across 18 days, using email and an optional professional-network step.
Each step includes a goal, delay, exit-on-reply, exit-on-opt-out, exit-on-bounce, and a natural endpoint.
Guardrails: accurate identity, non-deceptive subject, postal address, working unsubscribe, and counsel review.

output_examples.input: Plan warmup for three new mailboxes on a fresh domain without historical sending data.
output: Week 1: 5 estimated daily sends per mailbox. Week 2: 10. Week 3: 20. Week 4: 30, subject to signal review.
The steady-state cap remains conditional on bounce, complaint, authentication, and provider data.

output_examples.input: Route replies and identify unresolved compliance inputs for a mixed-jurisdiction list.
output: Positive: hand to sales. Objection: route to a response. Referral: record contact. Not-now: set a date. Opt-out: suppress immediately.
No reply category continues automatically. Missing lawful basis remains NEEDS_INPUT.

best_practices: Confirm list source, jurisdiction, and lawful basis before any campaign begins.
Stop every active step immediately after a reply, opt-out, or hard bounce.
Label volume benchmarks as estimated until authentication, bounce, complaint, and provider evidence is available.
anti_patterns: Continuing an automated sequence after a reply or opt-out request.
Treating missing consent, authentication, or reputation evidence as a passing result.
Increasing fresh-mailbox volume without warmup, signal review, or a documented cap.

faq.question: Does this skill send email?
faq.answer: No. It designs the sequence, routing, warmup schedule, controls, and handoff information.

faq.question: Does it provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It provides operational guidance and directs users to confirm jurisdiction-specific requirements with qualified counsel.

faq.question: Which inputs produce the best result?
faq.answer: Provide the ICP, list source, jurisdictions, mailbox count, domain age, authentication status, bounce rate, complaint rate, and consent record.

faq.question: Does it write subjects and email bodies?
faq.answer: No. It defines each step's purpose and timing, then hands creative work to a separate email-writing skill.

faq.question: How does it handle missing data?
faq.answer: It marks required evidence as NEEDS_INPUT or N/A. Category-standard warmup values are labeled as estimated.

faq.question: Can it calculate the complete email quality score?
faq.answer: No. It reads the sender-integrity dimension and passes evidence to the separate email quality auditor.
